checks.text: The page shows the heading "Hash Generator" and, with an empty input, the text "Enter text to hash".

Typing "hello" in the code area labelled "Input text", selecting "SHA-256" in the select labelled "Algorithm" and "hex" in the select labelled "Encoding" shows the value "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824" in the field labelled "Result".
With "hello" as input, selecting "SHA-1" and "base64" shows the value "qvTGHdzF6KLavt4PO0gs2a6pQ00=" in "Result". (SHA-1("hello") = aaf4c61ddcc5e8a2dabede0f3b482cd9aea9434d in hex.)

With "hello" as input, selecting "SHA-256" and "url" shows the value "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824" in "Result" (the "url" encoding percent-encodes the hex string, which has only unreserved characters, so it is unchanged).
With "hello" hashed as SHA-256 hex, clicking the button "Copy result" changes its label to "Copied" and the clipboard content is "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824".

With "hello" hashed as SHA-256 hex, clicking the button "Add to history" adds a row to the table labelled "History" containing the cells "hello", "SHA-256", "hex" and "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824".
After adding that row to history, clicking the button "Clear history" removes all data rows and the table area shows the text "No history yet".

With "hello" as input, selecting "SHA-512" and "hex" shows the value "9b71d224bd62f3785d96d46ad3ea3d73319bfbc2890caadae2dff72519673ca72323c3d99ba5c11d7c7acc6e14b8c5da0c4663475c2e5c3adef46f73bcdec043" in "Result" (128 hex characters).

After adding "hello" / SHA-256 / hex to history and reloading, the History table still contains a row with "hello", "SHA-256", "hex" and "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824".
